summary: Tested TASK 2 (Saved Filters) end-to-end via UI with pre-seeded localStorage, and TASK 1 (Save From Chat) at the code level per request. TASK 2 PASSED: filter row renders with chips All/Photos/Videos showing correct counts (5/3/2), clicking each filter correctly narrows the saved-grid (video->2 videos only, image->3 images only, all->all 5), selected chip is highlighted with bg-brand, and saved-filter-empty renders when the active filter has no items. TASK 1 code gating verified in Messages.tsx line 1617: the dm-media-save button only renders when `viewer.allowSave && !viewer.viewOnce && viewer.url`, and the handler calls saveMedia() + recordSaved() + showToast('Saved to your device') (lines 1621-1624) — correctly suppresses the button for view-once or allow_save=false DMs. End-to-end UI DM save was not exercised because strangers cannot DM on the Render backend (per request's agent note).
critical_code_review_comments: Messages.tsx is 2618 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the viewer, composer, and list into dedicated modules in a future refactor (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Pre-seeded localStorage key cc_saved_media with 3 image + 2 video items for filter testing; cleared after test (empty-state verification removed videos).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Saved Filters (TASK 2) are fully working end-to-end. For TASK 1 end-to-end DM save, a connected pair of users is required; a future test could seed a follow/accept relationship via /api/follows before attempting api.sendDmMedia between two dev-token accounts to exercise the dm-media-save button in the live viewer.
